notes: Phobos Medical care pack (0.1.0): each station's electrical demand and who counts as injured. The healing itself is the game's own Recuperating (CONDSleepingMedicalPer), not these figures. All thresholds are authored gameplay balance on the game's own scales, not clinical values. Player files in BepInEx/config/PhobosMedical/care override entries by name; see docs/editing-data-files.md.

bed.notes: Halewright Ward-3 Medical Bed. Idle is the vanilla Infirmaway's own draw (22.5 W); working adds the bed's care systems while a patient is under care.

monitor.notes: Halewright Vigil-2 Patient Monitor (0.3.0): a small draw while switched on, more while it watches a patient.

admission.notes: Injured when any figure reaches its threshold, a wound bleeds or a fracture is unsplinted. Blood lost and infection on the game's 0 to 40 and 0 to 95 scales, pain on its 0 to 75 scale, wound as the worst cut or blunt damage 0 to 1. A resting patient gets up once every figure is below threshold times dischargeShare.

alerts.notes: When a Vigil-2 posts a caution to the crew log (0.3.0): when a figure rises to its threshold, on the same scales as admission. It warns again once the figure has fallen below four fifths of its threshold and risen again. A wound that starts bleeding always alerts. The game's own shock bands start at blood lost 15 and 30, infection 35 and 65, pain 50 and 75.

bed.notes: What the Ward-3 adds to the game's own Recuperating (0.2.0). weightlessHealing is the share of normal wound healing a weightless patient keeps under care: the game's own figure is 0.05 (a twentieth); 1 removes the penalty. Agent default 1, open to owner revision.

dress-bleeding.notes: Medical 0.4.0. A clean scrap cloth on a bleeding wound: the game's own clean-dressing slot effect staunches it. Seconds and order are authored gameplay balance.

splint-fracture.notes: Medical 0.4.0. The game's own splint on an unsplinted broken arm or leg; its slot effect splints the fracture.

change-dressing.notes: Medical 0.4.0. A dressing the game has turned dirty comes off onto the deck and a clean scrap cloth goes on, so the wound stops picking up the dirty dressing's infection.
